cards.title: Review: the I form
cards.body: Take off -ar/-er/-ir, add -o, stress the second-to-last syllable. Comer → como (not 'comero'). Como also means 'how' or 'like', as in ¿cómo estás? (how are you?).

cards.title: -ar verbs: the biggest group
cards.body: Most Spanish verbs end in -ar, and every new verb joins this group: tuitear (to tweet), googlear. For forms other than 'I', -ar verbs follow one pattern and -er/-ir verbs another.

cards.title: -a = he / she / it / you (formal)
cards.body: -ar verbs are built around the 'a' sound. For he/she/it/formal you, end the verb in -a. Take long words syllable by syllable.

cards.title: durar = to last; mucho = a lot
cards.body: No obvious link from 'last', but duration → durar. 'It lasts a long time' is 'it lasts much'.

cards.title: exagerar
cards.body: The English 'j' sound in exaggeration becomes the throaty g sound.

cards.title: Spanish can teach you English
cards.body: Masticar (to chew) explains English 'mastication'. Morder (to bite) explains 'mordant'. Learning Spanish Latin can grow your English vocabulary too.

cards.title: -an = they / you (plural)
cards.body: Add n to the -a form for 'they' and plural 'you' (you all).

cards.title: hablar = to speak
cards.body: The h is silent. Voy a hablar: the two a sounds blend together when spoken quickly.

cards.title: -as = you (informal)
cards.body: Add s to the -a form to speak to one person informally.

cards.title: Where me, te, lo, la go
cards.body: With a conjugated verb (one not ending in r), the little word goes in front: lo quiero. With a 'to' form after it, you can attach it to the end or put it in front. Both mean the same.

cards.title: hablarlo = to talk about it
cards.body: No word for 'about' needed: 'speak it' is understood as 'speak about it'.

examples.en: It's important to talk about it.

practice.why: elimina = she deletes; the little word goes before: lo elimina.
With a changed verb, lo goes in front.

practice.en: It's important to talk about it.

practice.why: Both positions are fine with a 'to' form.
